Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; HAVEN FOR HEROES. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Haven for Heroes.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HAVEN FOR HEROES.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Haven for Heroes to plan and design a museum chronicling the history of the Anoka State Hospital and the history of mental health care and to preserve the historic auditorium at the state hospital campus in Anoka.
additions: $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Haven for Heroes to plan and design a museum chronicling the history of the Anoka State Hospital and the history of mental health care and to preserve the historic auditorium at the state hospital campus in Anoka.
